speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing both a psychiatric condition and a new onset movement disorder. To help me understand your situation, can you please describe the specific psychiatric symptoms you are experiencing and when they started?

speaker: Patient
text: 23-year-old college student. The patient is here for a follow-up appointment. He was recently diagnosed with schizophrenia and started on risperidone approximately 2 months ago. Reports a significant improvement in psychiatric symptoms since the start of treatment.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is good to hear regarding your psychiatric improvement. However, you mentioned a new movement disorder; can you describe exactly what movements you are experiencing and when they started relative to beginning risperidone?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Inability to remain still, persistent feeling of restlessness. I also have Frequent fidgeting, Repetitive crossing and uncrossing of legs, Pacing.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for describing those symptoms; they sound very much like akathisia, a common side effect of risperidone. Given your recent diagnosis of schizophrenia, have you noticed any worsening of your anxiety or inability to sit still since starting the medication?
